meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和格式化 Word 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码生成或处理 Word 文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and format Word documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or process Word documents programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会创建、读取、编辑 Word 文档和模板(.docx/.dotx),也能添加批注、接受修订,并把成品转成 PDF 检查排版。
howto.when: 当你提到“Word 文档”“.docx”“.dotx”,或要求制作/修改带目录页眉等排版的 Word 文件,或要提取内容、加批注、接受修订时触发。

say.text: 生成一份 Word 报告,带目录、标题样式和页码。
say.note: 会用脚本创建文档,再转 PDF 自检排版。

say.text: 给合同里“费用上限”加批注,注明“此处上限太低”。
say.note: 批注要锚定到具体文字才会显示。

say.text: 接受这个文档里所有修订,另存为 final.docx。
say.note: 得到已接受全部修订的干净副本。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can create, read, and edit Word documents and templates (.docx/.dotx), add comments, accept tracked changes, and render the result to PDF to inspect the layout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Word doc', '.docx', '.dotx', or request a Word file with formatted layout (table of contents, headings, page numbers), or ask to extract, replace, or annotate content.

say_en.text: Generate a Word report with a table of contents, heading styles, and page numbers.
say_en.note: Creates the file, then renders it to PDF to inspect the layout.

say_en.text: Add a comment to 'fee cap' in the contract that says 'this cap is too low'.
say_en.note: The comment appears only after being anchored to that text.

say_en.text: Accept all tracked changes in this document and save the result as final.docx.
say_en.note: Returns a clean copy with changes accepted.
